notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: D0 (shared mob registry), D (trial spawners, vaults, lodestones, breezes), W (darkness, vibrations, sculk, warden), E1 and E2 (known limits), F (Elden Ring boss), later M1-M3 (remaining mobs). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new enum variants, match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small. Record decisions in the track log. RESTARTS: if this run was started again after a stop (the PC crashed on 2026-10-28 at 20:27 with six tracks building), the worktree may hold the current group's half-done work as uncommitted or staged changes: read `git status` and `git diff` (and `git diff --cached`) first, keep what is correct, finish the group and commit it; discard only what is broken. If cargo reports invalid or corrupt metadata, a truncated .rlib/.rmeta or a link error on a file that should exist, run `& .\scripts\cargo-slot.ps1 +target=<this track's target> clean -p <crate>` for that crate and build again. LOAD: builds now run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. RESUME 2026-11-02: this run resumes the segment after the week's stop on 2026-10-29 at 17:30. The repo moved to C:\Dev\Soscraft\mashup-crafting and the worktrees to C:\Dev\Soscraft\mc-wt\<track>; briefs, logs and specs in this branch may still name C:\Dev\mashup-crafting or C:\Dev\mc-wt: use the new paths. The first cargo command in this worktree rebuilds the workspace crates because their source path changed: slow but expected, not a corrupt build. Never amend, rebase or rewrite history: the 'Unfinished:' WIP commit stays in history and its group is finished in new commits with the brief's subjects. SINCE THE STOP: minecraft-survival (8f7410e6) was merged into track-e1 before this run, so the branch now also holds D's d2 (breezes, fd93ce96), E1's e1b (23b449ef) and PROTOCOL 10 (e7c9a1c8), plus the other tracks' earlier merges. Nothing was built after that merge: the first group makes `check -p launcher` green and fixes any breakage the merge caused in a commit of its own. This segment's own net change is `git diff minecraft-survival...HEAD` (three dots) and its own commits are `git log --no-merges r10-e1b-base..HEAD --not minecraft-survival`; the reviewer and the final verification use those (not `git diff r10-e1b-base..HEAD`, which now includes other tracks' merged work) to find what to review and which crates were touched. THIS RUN'S REVIEW covers all of segment e1b, whose eight groups were merged into minecraft-survival unreviewed as 23b449ef: review `git diff r10-e1b-base 68c06510` (the eight groups), the conflict resolutions of 23b449ef (`git show --cc 23b449ef`) and the bells-outline commits (`git diff minecraft-survival...HEAD`). Fixes go on track-e1 as new commits. The final verification's touched crates are the union of `git diff --stat r10-e1b-base 68c06510` and `git diff --stat minecraft-survival...HEAD`.
